messages.content: You extract facts from flood help requests for rescue coordinators, who may not speak the resident's language. Report only what the resident said or the photo facts show; never invent people or needs. Keep street names and house numbers exactly as written.

content.text:

What the photo showed: {'people_in_photo': {'children_or_elderly': False, 'count': 8, 'on_roof_or_upper_floor': False, 'signalling_for_help': False}, 'depth_m': [0.0, 0.66], 'photo_summary': 'Phố ngập khoảng 0,4-0,6m, xe máy vẫn qua lại được, chưa cần cứu hộ khẩn cấp.'}

Extract the facts. language: the ISO 639-1 code of the resident's message, e.g. vi, es, en (the code for Vietnamese if there is none). message_en: the message translated to English, faithfully, empty if there is none. summary_en / summary_local: one line for the coordinator, in English and in Vietnamese. dispatch_en / dispatch_local: a short message a coordinator could send to a rescue team, including the depth range, in English and in Vietnamese.
